title: 第2章 废后(2)
content_zh:
楣夫人是傅修宜东征时候遇到的臣子女儿，喜爱她解语懂事，带回宫中。楣夫人为傅修宜生了皇子傅盛，傅盛深得圣宠，倒是沈妙的儿子，太子傅明，不得圣心。
傅修宜曾经当着满朝文武说：“傅明性子太柔，还是傅盛肖似我儿。”话里明明白白的都是要改立太子的意思。
楣夫人让沈妙有了危机感，在宫中，沈妙和楣夫人斗了十年。楣夫人屡次占上风，甚至撺掇着傅修宜把亲生女儿婉瑜公主嫁给匈奴和亲，匈奴人好斗性狠，婉瑜公主在和亲途中就病逝了，当即火化，谁都知道这其中肯定有蹊跷，偏偏身为母亲的沈妙无可奈何。
到底还是走到了今日。
傅修宜一封圣旨，沈家谋反，太子被废，自刎谢罪，她这个皇后也要被废，得到了三尺白绫。
她只想问一句：“为什么？”
沈妙道：“傅修宜，你有没有良心？你我夫妻二十余载，我自问没有对不住你的地方。当初你登基，是我沈家助你，你出征，匈奴来犯，我替你写降书，你想拉拢的大臣，我跪下来求他辅佐。赴邻国做人质，其中苦楚煎熬，你回报了我什么？楣夫人让婉瑜出嫁，你便拟旨，婉瑜才十六就病逝。你宠爱傅盛冷落傅明，举朝皆知。现在你屠戮我满门，死到临头，我便问你一句，为什么？”
“沈妙，”傅修宜皱眉，他的神情没有一丝动容，仿佛冷酷的雕像一般：“父皇在世的时候便商量对付几大世家，沈家功高盖主不可久留，是朕劝着父皇，朕多留了沈家二十年，已经是对沈家天大的恩赐了！”
已经是对沈家天大的恩赐了！沈妙身子晃了一晃，这些日子她哭的太多，眼泪已经流不出来了，她对着傅修宜，一字一句道：“为什么留着沈家？不是你仁慈，也不是你的恩赐，你只是想利用沈家的兵权来增加夺嫡的砝码。狡兔死，走狗烹，如今江山一定，你就过河拆桥，傅修宜，你好狠的心！”
“沈妙！”傅修宜怒喝一声，似是被戳到了痛处，冷哼一声，道：“你好自为之吧。”说罢拂袖而去。

沈妙伏在地上，握紧双拳，这就是她爱了一辈子的男人，在宫中和楣夫人为他争宠，到最后方才发现，不是争宠，是这男人的心从来都没有在她身上过！那些情话耳语，都不过是逢场作戏的笑话！
她“噗”的吐出一口鲜血。
“姐姐这是怎么了？看上去好生狼狈。”婉转的声音响起。
女子一身鹅黄轻薄小衫，芙蓉面，杨柳腰，模样顶顶赛天仙，姿势也优美动人，款款而来。
这是和沈妙斗了一辈子，也胜券在握的楣夫人。
楣夫人的身后还站着两名宫装打扮的女子，沈妙一愣：“沈清，沈玥！”
这是二房和三房，二叔和三叔的女儿，她的两个堂姐，怎么会在宫中？
“陛下召我姐妹入宫了，”沈玥掩唇笑道：“五妹妹不必惊讶，原先几年五妹妹爱替我姐妹打听人家做媒，如今倒不必了，陛下待我姐妹极好。”
“你…”沈妙心中如翻江倒海，电光石火间似是明白了一些从未想清楚的事情。她的声音有些不可置信：“你、你们迟迟不嫁，就是为了今日？”

“可不是呢。”沈清上前一步：“当初陛下和我爹三叔达成盟约，只要说动你嫁给陛下，终有一日，我姐妹二人也会有同样的归宿。”
当初沈妙能嫁给傅修宜，二房和三房可不是在其中出了不少力，如今想来，当初她爱慕上傅修宜，似乎也是二婶三婶整日的提起定王青年才俊，才让她萌生出好感。原来，是一早达成的协议么？原来，二房三房一早就暗藏祸心，等着今日一切的发生么？
沈清却生怕沈妙听不明白似的，继续道：“陛下丰神俊朗，我姐妹爱慕已久，偏偏只有大伯手握重权，不得已只能让五妹捷足先登。五妹前些年享了不少福，如今也时辰该到了。”
“沈清！”沈妙突然正起正起身子，高声道：“陛下抄了沈家，却让你二人进宫，二房和三房怎么会平安无事？”
“二房和三房当然会平安无事啦，”沈玥捂着嘴笑起来：“因为我们是大功臣，大伯造反的证据，可都是咱们两房大义灭亲指出来的。五妹，陛下还要封咱们两房大官呢。”
沈妙震惊的看着自己的两位堂姐，道：“你们疯了？覆巢之下焉有完卵？沈家是一家人，傅修宜要对付沈家，你们竟然陷害自家人……”
“自家人，五妹，我们可从没承认大房是自家人。”沈清冷笑一声：“再说你享受的实在太多了。如今太子已死，公主不再，沈家已亡，你还是早些下黄泉，跟他们团聚吧。”
楣夫人款款上前，微笑着道：“姐姐，江山定了，你也该退了。”
争了十年，沈妙到底是输的一塌糊涂，输的太惨，输的子丧族亡，输成了一个天大的笑话！
她恨恨的道：“本宫不死，尔等终究是妃！”
“陈公公，动手吧。”楣夫人冲太监使了个眼色。
身形肥硕的太监立刻上前几步，一手死死攥住沈妙的脖子，一手将盘子上的白绫套在沈妙的脖子上。用力一扯，白绫撕扯着骨肉，骨头发出清脆的响声。
那地上挣扎的女子瞪大双眼，心中无声的立下毒誓。
她的儿子，她的女儿，她的父母兄弟，姐妹仆人，沈家上上下下，全都被害了。
傅修宜，楣夫人，沈清，沈玥，所有害过她的人，害过她亲人的人，若有来世，血债血偿！
是日何时丧，予与汝皆亡！
content_en:
Mrs. Mei was the daughter of a courtier whom Fu Xiuyi met during his Eastern Expedition. He liked her for her understanding and understanding and brought her back to the palace. Mrs. Mei gave birth to the prince Fu Sheng for Fu Xiu Yi. Fu Sheng was favored by the Holy Spirit, but Shen Miao's son, Prince Fu Ming, was not favored by the Holy Heart.
Fu Xiu Yi once said in front of the civil and military officials of the court: "Fu Ming is too soft-tempered, but Fu Sheng is more like my son." His words clearly meant that he wanted to change the throne.
Mrs. Mei made Shen Miao feel a sense of crisis. In the palace, Shen Miao and Mrs. Mei fought for ten years. Mrs. Mei had the upper hand many times and even persuaded Fu Xiu Yi to marry his biological daughter Princess Wanyu to the Huns. The Huns were aggressive and cruel, so Princess Wanyu died of illness during the marriage and was immediately cremated. Everyone knew that there must be something fishy, ​​but as a mother, Shen Miao was helpless.
In the end, we have made it to today.
Fu Xiuyi issued an imperial edict that the Shen family had rebelled, the prince was deposed, and he committed suicide by committing suicide. She, the queen, was also deposed and got three feet of white silk.
She just wanted to ask: "Why?"
Shen Miao said: "Fu Xiu Yi, do you have a conscience? You and I have been husband and wife for more than 20 years, and I ask myself that I have nothing to do with you. When you came to the throne, it was my Shen family who helped you. When you went on an expedition and the Huns invaded, I wrote a letter of surrender for you. For the ministers you wanted to win over, I knelt down and begged for his assistance. Go. What did you repay me for being a hostage in a neighboring country? When Mrs. Mei asked Wan Yu to marry, you made a decree, and Wan Yu died of illness when she was only sixteen. It is known to everyone that you favored Fu Sheng and neglected Fu Ming. Now that you are about to die, I ask you, why?"
"Shen Miao," Fu Xiu Yi frowned. His expression was not moved at all, like a cold statue: "When my father was still alive, he discussed how to deal with several big families. The Shen family is so powerful that the master cannot stay for a long time. It was I who persuaded my father. I have stayed in the Shen family for twenty more years. It is already a great gift to the Shen family!"
This is already a great gift to the Shen family! Shen Miao's body swayed. She had cried too much these days and her tears could no longer be shed. She said to Fu Xiu Yi word for word: "Why keep the Shen family? It's not your kindness, nor your gift. You just want to use the Shen family's military power to increase the weight of the heir. If the cunning rabbit dies, the lackey will cook. Now that the country is determined, you will burn the bridge across the river. Fu Xiu Yi, you are so cruel!"
"Shen Miao!" Fu Xiu Yi shouted angrily, as if he had been stabbed in a sore spot, he snorted coldly and said: "You can take care of yourself." After saying that, he walked away.

Shen Miao lay on the ground and clenched her fists. This was the man she had loved all her life. She competed with Mrs. Mei for his favor in the palace. Only in the end did she realize that it was not a fight for favor, but that this man's heart had never been in her! Those whispers of love are nothing but jokes!
She spat out a mouthful of blood.
"Sister, what's wrong? You look so embarrassed." A gentle voice sounded.
The woman is wearing a light yellow blouse, with a hibiscus face and a willow waist. She looks like a fairy, and her posture is also graceful and elegant.
This is Mrs. Mei who has been fighting with Shen Miao all her life and is sure of victory.
Behind Mrs. Mei stood two women in palace attire. Shen Miao was stunned: "Shen Qing, Shen Yue!"
These are the second and third bedrooms, the daughters of the second uncle and the third uncle. How come her two cousins are in the palace?
"Your Majesty has summoned my sister to the palace," Shen Yue covered her lips and said with a smile, "Fifth sister, don't be surprised. In the past few years, fifth sister liked to inquire about others and act as matchmaker for my sister, but now it is no longer necessary. Your Majesty treats my sister very well."
"You..." Shen Miao's heart was turbulent, and she seemed to understand something that she had never thought clearly before. Her voice was a little unbelievable: "You, you are delaying getting married just for today?"
"That's not true." Shen Qing took a step forward: "At the beginning, Your MajestyYour Majesty and my third uncle have reached an agreement. As long as I persuade you to marry Your Majesty, one day my two sisters will have the same fate. "
When Shen Miao was able to marry Fu Xiu Yi, the second and third wives did not have a lot of help. Now thinking about it, when she fell in love with Fu Xiu Yi, it seemed that it was the second aunt and the third aunt who mentioned the young talent of Prince Ding all day long that made her fall in love with him. So, was it an agreement reached early in the morning? It turns out that the second and third bedrooms had hidden evil intentions early in the morning, waiting for everything to happen today?
Shen Qing was afraid that Shen Miao would not understand, so he continued: "Your Majesty is rich and handsome, my sisters have admired you for a long time, but only the uncle holds the most power, so I had no choice but to let the fifth sister get there first. Fifth sister has enjoyed a lot of blessings in the past few years, and now the time has come. "
"Shen Qing! Shen Miao suddenly stood up and said loudly: "Your Majesty raided the Shen family, but allowed you two to enter the palace. How could the second and third rooms be safe?" "
"Of course the second and third bedrooms will be safe and sound," Shen Yue covered her mouth and laughed: "Because we are the great contributors, and the evidence of uncle's rebellion was pointed out by our second bedroom. Fifth sister, Your Majesty also wants to make us two high-ranking officials. "
Shen Miao looked at her two cousins in shock and said: "Are you crazy? How can there be eggs under the cover of the nest? The Shen family is a family, Fu Xiuyi wants to deal with the Shen family, and you actually framed your own family..."
"My family, Fifth Sister, we have never admitted that Dafang is our family. Shen Qing sneered: "Besides, you enjoy too much." Now that the prince is dead, the princess is no longer there, and the Shen family is dead, you'd better go to hell as soon as possible and reunite with them. "
Mrs. Mei stepped forward and said with a smile: "Sister, the situation is decided, it's time for you to retreat. "
After ten years of fighting, Shen Miao lost completely. She lost so miserably that her family was wiped out and her family was wiped out. Shen Miao's loss turned into a big joke!
She said bitterly: "As long as I die, you will be the concubine after all! "
"Eunuch Chen, let's do it. "Mrs. Mei winked at the eunuch.
The plump eunuch immediately took a few steps forward, firmly grasped Shen Miao's neck with one hand, and put the white silk on the plate around Shen Miao's neck with the other hand. Pulling hard, Bai Ling tore at the bones and flesh, and the bones made a crisp sound.
The woman struggling on the ground widened her eyes and silently swore a poisonous oath in her heart.
Her son, her daughter, her parents, brothers, sisters and servants, the entire Shen family were all killed.
Fu Xiu Yi, Mrs. Mei, Shen Qing, Shen Yue, all those who have harmed her, and those who have harmed her relatives, if there is an afterlife, they will pay with blood!
When will we die on this day? I and you will both die!
